newsitem.title: USA: Nichols Research gets contract options.
newsitem.headline: Nichols Research gets contract options.

text.p: Nichols Research Corp said on Friday that the federal government has exercised contract options for a computer modernization program valued at $58.7 million at two locations.
The work will be performed at the Aeronautical Systems Center at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base in Ohio and the Corps of Engineers Waterways Experiment Station in Vicksburg, Miss., Nichols said.

The options provide for system integration, support infrastructure services and training in support of the two Department of Defense's centers, Nichols said. Remaining portions of these contracts are expected to be completed by April 1999, the company said.
